title: The Ultimate Messy Data Sanitizer & Multi-Format Converter
target_pain: Manually cleaning messy CSV, TSV, or JSON data (removing duplicates, trimming whitespace, fixing casing, filtering empty rows) and converting between formats is tedious, error-prone, and repetitive.
key_features: Auto-detects CSV, TSV, and JSON input formats
Trims whitespace, removes duplicates, and filters empty rows instantly
Find & Replace with regular expression support
Case conversion (UPPER, lower, Title Case) for specific columns or all data
Exports to clean JSON, CSV, TSV, or Markdown tables
100% client-side processing for maximum data privacy
